newsitem.title: FRANCE: French budget deficit narrowed in October.
newsitem.headline: French budget deficit narrowed in October.

text.p: The French Finance Ministry said in a statement that the budget deficit stood at 286.4 billion francs at end-October, an improvement of 23.1 billion francs over the 309.5 billion franc deficit at end-October 1995.
In a statement, the ministry said the reduction of the deficit was due to an increase in company tax and lower contributions to the European Community.
It said that total revenues were 1,099.2 billion francs at end-October 1996, up 7.2 percent from last year.
Of this, fiscal revenues were up 5.8 percent to 1,134.7 billion, non fiscal revenues rose 10.3 percent to 106.3 billion and pre-payments on charges were 2.7 percent higher at 200.7 billion franc.
General budget spending was 4.5 percent higher at end-October at 1,334.5 billion franc.
